no_outcome_promised.note: The draft restates the request to restore the old format or show the balance at the top without committing to either.

no_liability_admitted.note: "Sorry for the frustration" expresses empathy for the customer's experience. It does not say the statement design was wrong or that the bank erred.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: The only timeline is the standard 10 business days. The invitation to reply by email matches the channel and adds no new procedure or policy.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems are mentioned.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no embedded instructions, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: The draft covers the hard-to-read format, the missing principal balance, the call needed to learn the amount owed, the old one-page format, and both requested remedies.

tone.note: Warm, plain and respectful. Not defensive or condescending.

mode_respected.note: The draft frames everything as the customer's account ("You told us", "You mentioned") and takes no position on the statement design. It says a specialist team is reviewing the complaint without naming Mortgage Servicing.
